findings: Untyped POST body in /runs — payload: dict[str, Any] bypasses FastAPI automatic 422 validation; a non-numeric volume_tons surfaces as 500 instead of structured 422. Fix: accept RunInput directly as the body parameter.

delta_mass filter in list_audit_exceptions — float(a.get('delta_mass', 0.0)) > 0.02 silently evaluates to False for every record if AuditRecord.to_dict() does not populate that field. Verify the field is populated downstream or rename to the correct attribute.
422 vs 409/500 when WorkflowRun has no temporal_workflow_id in settlement.py — a found-but-incomplete record should return 409 or 500, not 422 (which signals bad client input).
hitl_required APPROVE update in settlement.py opens a second DB session without repeating the org_id guard; safe today due to UUID run_id, but asymmetric with the first lookup.
